name: EZSnsRF
description: A plug-in receiver that turns codes from Dakota Alert 3000-series wireless transmitters, such as motion, driveway, contact and liquid sensors, into Insteon scene commands, for up to 20 scenes.
notes: Each transmitter has 10 DIP switches that give it a code; Dakota Alert 3000-series transmitters reach up to 600 feet. It has a pass-through outlet, which shouldn't power anything that emits radio signals.
The commands each code sends when its signal turns on and off are programmable, so no document gives them.

To learn a transmitter and link responders: hold the SET button about 4 seconds (the LED flashes about once a second); trigger the transmitter (the LED flashes faster); hold the SET button of each responder about 4 seconds; end by holding the EZSnsRF's SET button 4 seconds. Then tap it 1 to 31 times to add an Off delay of half a minute per tap, from 0.5 to 15.5 minutes, and hold it 4 seconds; with no delay, tap it once more to finish. Holding the SET button 4 seconds cancels at any step.
Factory reset: unplug it for at least 5 seconds, then hold the SET button while plugging it back in, for 5 seconds more.
The Quick-Start Guide (Rev 1.5) applies to firmware 1.6 and above.
sources: Quick-Start Guide EZSnsRF Wireless Sensor Receiver Model #5010E
